caption:
Paid stops the day you do.

Watch the three lines.

PAID ALONE — every spike costs money and every spike comes back to zero. You are renting the attention. The day the card declines, the line is flat. You own nothing you paid for.

CONTENT ALONE — no spikes. Just a base that is a little higher than it was last month, and the month before that. It compounds. It is also slow, and the honest part of that chart is how long it spends under the line.

BOTH — the money lands on a base that is already climbing. Same spend as the first chart. Different result, because it is not starting from zero every time.

That is the whole argument. Paid buys you this month. Content buys you next year. Run one without the other and you are either renting forever or waiting forever.

No numbers in this one, on purpose. The axes have no scale, because how much faster depends on your market, your offer and what you have already built. Anyone who puts a multiple on it is guessing.

We run both.

DM us and we will tell you which of the three charts your account is currently on.
